full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg., cor EDSA Mapagmahal Street, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 65 S. May 27, 2010 ENGR. ROGER M. ESTO Former Municipal Mayor Municipality of Libacao Province of Aklan Dear Sir: This has particular reference to your earlier letter seeking our legal opinion on whether or not you, who later on won as Mayor by virtue of an election protest, may still recover the salaries and other form of benefits appürtenant to said office during the year that the same was held by your opponent, the person who had been proclaimed as winner and had initially assumed said office but who was later ousted as a result of the election protest. In reply thereto, please be informed that we have already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 50 series of 2007. Attached herewith is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready reference. Thank you. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: . DOQ ATTY. JESU Director III Legal:20/corz 2010
